    // How it works

    From curious to capable, in four moves

    No subscriptions to nothing. Each step ends with something you can show.

    01

    Pick a track

    Six tracks, each a sequence of courses rather than a list.

    02

    Learn in short blocks

    Twenty-minute lessons with a project you finish the same week.

    03

    Meet a mentor live

    Weekly office hours and critique nights in the live room.

    04

    Ship something real

    Finish with a project and a certificate you can show.

    // Questions

    Before you start

    Both exist. Individual courses are one-off purchases with lifetime access. The Live plan adds every live session, every replay and the library for a monthly or annual fee.

    Every session is recorded and published to the archive within a few hours. Registrants get the replay automatically, along with any resources shared in the room.

    Yes. Courses and cohorts issue a certificate of completion with a verifiable ID. Certificates name the course, the hours and the instructor.

    Teams can purchase seats by invoice, with a purchase order and a single consolidated invoice. We also provide a written syllabus for procurement.

    Courses assume two to three hours a week. Cohorts assume four to five, including a live session and one piece of work you will show to the group.

    Start with one course. Keep the loop going.

    Free courses need no card. Paid courses come with 30 days to change your mind.
